question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

You can learn about the well ways to make money.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**well**."
 
• The word "**well**" is incorrect in this context and should be replaced with "**best**" or a similar adjective that accurately describes the ways to make money.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**about the best ways to make money**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"You can learn** about the best ways** to make money."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **You can learn** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **ways to make money.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in option 1.
